submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a threshold of 34 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.268% among all tested configurations across the three candidate algorithms. This configuration was identified through systematic efficiency measurements at multiple threshold points (20, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 38, 40, 50, and 60 GeV) for all three algorithms. Algorithm-L1 consistently outperformed Algorithm-L2 (peak efficiency 73.518% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (peak efficiency 83.893% at 30 GeV). The 34 GeV threshold represents the optimal operating point that maximizes signal efficiency while operating within the 8 kHz rate allocation. Final confirmation simulation validated an efficiency of 91.558%, confirming the robustness of this choice. This configuration meets the project goal of achieving the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
